jobs.description: Would you like to contribute to flawless mail delivery and are you looking for a flexible part-time job? Become a mail preparer at our client in Assen! In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that mail is correctly sorted and prepared for dispatch.As a mail preparer in Assen, you are responsible for accurately sorting incoming mail. You will check addresses and shipping details and use various mail processing machines to handle the mail efficiently. The job requires precision and good physical condition, as you will be working primarily on your feet. You should also be open to working overtime to assist your colleagues during backlogs or busy periods.What we ask for:- No minimum educational requirements;- Precision and attention to detail;- Enthusiastic and motivated attitude;- You speak either Dutch or English;

As a Warehouse Employee, you will work at a technical manufacturing company in Geldrop. Together with a small team of 5 to 6 colleagues, you will make sure that all goods end up in the right place and that orders are packed and shipped correctly and on time.Your work will be varied. You will be responsible for loading and unloading goods, checking incoming deliveries, and preparing orders for shipment. You will also help manage stock levels and make sure everything is stored in the correct location. Incoming goods are registered in the company's ERP system.You will work in a clean and well-organized environment where colleagues support each other and communication is straightforward. There are plenty of opportunities to learn new skills and develop yourself further.- You have experience in logistics, preferably in shipping and receiving- You have an MBO-level education or equivalent working experience- You speak Dutch and/or English- Experience working with an ERP system is preferred- You enjoy physical work and are comfortable with an active working day

Are you organized, proactive and looking for an international logistics challenge?Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced international environment where no two days are the same? For Dorel Juvenile, the company behind brands such as Maxi-Cosi and Tiny Love, we are looking for an enthusiastic Export Assistant. In this role, you will support export operations, coordinate international shipments, and ensure excellent customer service throughout the entire order process.What will you do?As an Export Assistant, you will be responsible for managing export orders from start to finish and ensuring that shipments are delivered accurately and on time.Your responsibilities include:- Receiving, processing and managing customer orders.- Verifying order details, product availability and delivery schedules.- Coordinating and optimizing order flows for distributors.- Identifying potential issues or delays and resolving them proactively.- Acting as the main point of contact for customers regarding orders and deliveries.- Planning and coordinating international shipments.- Ensuring compliance with customer-specific and country-specific shipping requirements.- Coordinating with internal departments and external logistics partners.- Handling customer claims and spare parts requests.- Following up on customer inquiries and ensuring timely resolutions.What do you bring?- Fluency in English, both written and spoken.- Previous experience in logistics, preferably in export operations or order management.- Strong organizational and planning skills.- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.- A proactive and solution-oriented mindset.- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.- A hands-on attitude and team spirit.

As an assembly worker, you will be responsible for assembling and testing electronic products in a modern, high-tech working environment. You will work full-time on the evening shift from 3:00 PM to midnight. You will work with tasks such as screwing, manual gluing, assembly, and functional testing. You may also operate robots and be responsible for programming and quality control.You will carefully record your work and work closely with your fellow assembly workers to meet deadlines and maintain high-quality standards. Are you technically skilled and looking for a full-time job as a process operator in Heerenveen? In this role, you will join a leading producer of margarines, oils, and fats. You will monitor the production process, ensure quality and safety, and directly contribute to customer satisfaction. Do you want to work in the food industry with excellent career opportunities and a great team atmosphere? Read on to discover your new challenge!As a process operator, you will be responsible for running and supervising a modern production line where margarine, oils, and fats are manufactured and packaged. You will monitor the entire process, adjust machines when needed, and perform quality checks on finished products. With your technical insight and attention to detail, you make sure production runs smoothly, safely, and according to the highest quality standards.This is a 3-shift schedule position, giving you variety in your work as well as extra free time. It’s a dynamic role with plenty of opportunities to grow and develop.We are looking for a process operator with the following skills and qualifications:- Technical affinity or work experience as an operator/process operator;- Experience in a production environment, preferably in the food industry;- Motivated, eager to learn, and detail-oriented;- Strong focus on quality, hygiene, and safety;- Availability for a full-time 40-hour work week;- Willingness to work in a 3-shift schedule;- Good command of the Dutch or English language (spoken and written).

As a Shipboard Electrician, you will be responsible for installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting electrical systems onboard ships and maritime installations. You will work with a variety of systems, including power distribution, lighting, navigation equipment, automation systems, and communication networks.Your daily responsibilities include:- Installing and connecting electrical systems onboard vessels;- Reading and interpreting technical drawings and electrical schematics;- Inspecting, testing, and commissioning maritime electrical installations;- Diagnosing and resolving electrical and technical faults;- Performing maintenance and repair activities on onboard systems;- Supporting refit, modernization, and new-build projects.You will primarily work at shipyards, ports, and onboard vessels, with occasional travel required for project support and sea trials.- Completed MBO education in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field;- Relevant experience as an electrician, preferably within shipbuilding, maritime, or offshore environments;- Knowledge of maritime electrical systems and regulations is an advantage;- Valid VCA certificate or willingness to obtain one;- Driving license B;- Flexible, proactive, and solution-oriented attitude;- Ability to work independently and as part of a team;- Good command of Dutch and/or English.

High-tech machinery, daytime shifts and plenty of opportunities. A role with perspective, a competitive salary, and the space to develop yourself. Wie zoeken we? As an assembly technician in high-tech machine building you are accurate, practical and quality-oriented. You understand better than anyone how important it is that every machine delivers exactly what the customer requires. You work independently or together with colleagues on assembling and testing complex modules and systems. You solve problems quickly and proactively, and you naturally enjoy supporting your colleagues and sharing your knowledge. Technicial background or education Interest in fine mechanics and precision work Accuracy and strong attention to detail Good command of English and the ability to follow instructions Wat bieden wij je? As an assembly technician in high-tech machine building, you can of course expect something in return for your efforts. You will have a varied role in daytime shifts within a dedicated team of specialists. There is plenty of room for development, training, and career growth. In addition, you will work in a pleasant, informal environment with opportunities for team activities. A gross monthly salary between €3.000 and €4.200 based on a 40-hour week A one-year contract with the client, with prospects for a permanent position 27 vacation days and 13 additional days off Participation in the PME pension fund (Metalektro) Informal working atmosphere with opportunities for team activities Functieomschrijving As an Assembly Technician in high-tech machine building you will assemble and test advanced machines used for wafer processing with plasma technology. These machines are essential to the semiconductor industry, a vital sector powering the technology behind everything from smartphones and medical devices to cars, smart appliances and sustainable energy solutions. You will work in a cleanroom environment. Depending on the size of the machine you will either handle thbuild independently or together with one or two colleagues. While some standard machines are delivered, no two machines are ever the same since each one is fully customized to the client’s specifications. Once you know the machines inside out you will also perform the final testing and prepare the accompanying test reports, making sure the machines deliver exactly as promised. This is a highly responsible role as you will be working with precision equipment. You will also support less experienced colleagues, contributing directly to the team and the quality of the machines. Your work makes an immediate difference in the performance of these products. Assembling high-tech machines and components in a cleanroom environment Testing and inspecting the functionality of the systems Identifying and resolving technical issues during the assembly process Adapting machines to meet specific customer requirements and needs Where will you be working? You will join an innovative company in the semiconductor industry, based in Nijmegen. This high-tech organisation develops and builds machines for the global market, with locations in Europe, China and the United States. The production department in Nijmegen consists of around 20 colleagues who share a passion for technology. The atmosphere is informal and supportive – you are never on your own. Ready to take the next step as an assembly technician in high-tech? Apply today and we will get in touch with you soon.

Ready to make a direct impact on the technology of tomorrow? At Prodrive in Eindhoven, we are looking for a PCBA Operator responsible for assembling high-quality printed circuit boards. Will you choose a challenging role with the best benefits in the region? What we offer We believe in rewarding craftsmanship and dedication. Therefore, you can count on:  - Salary & Contract: An excellent monthly salary between €3160 including a 2-shift allowance, with the prospect of a permanent contract. - Time off: An incredible 33 vacation days and 13 ADV days per year (46 days off in total!). - Health & Food: Free daily meals and complimentary access to our in-house gym. Who are you? You are an accurate worker with a passion for technology. Furthermore, you bring the following:  - A completed vocational education (MBO) in technology or relevant production experience. - Experience in reading technical drawings and precise instructions. - The willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule. - Good communication skills in English. Are you looking for a clean and technical job with good pay and the chance of a permanent contract? Start as a Cleanroom Employee in Eindhoven. You can follow clear instructions and enjoy working together with colleagues. That is helpful, but not required.

In this role, you are the guardian of quality for highly specialized processes within an international high-tech company. The company develops, repairs, and inspects critical components for the aerospace, energy, and defense industries.
